questions.prompt: True or false: “A refrigerator is a system used for keeping things cold.”

hints.nudge: Read the statement slowly. Does it match what the article says, or has one word been swapped for another?
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Refrigerator article.

questions.proof: A refrigerator is a machine used for keeping things cold.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “There are also ice _____ that do not use electricity because they are filled with ice to provide the colder temperature.”
